summary: Advances a collision contact buffer by timestep a2. Accumulates the timestep into the contact time accumulator at this+0. When the accumulated time exceeds the overflow threshold flt_59E43C, the contact impulse accumulators (this+4, this+8) are normalized by the reciprocal of the accumulated time, the scaled outputs are written to this+0xC and this+0x10, and all three accumulators are reset to zero. A final loop of 104 iterations adds the timestep to each contact-pair timer entry. Returns a pointer past the timer block.

operations.description: Accumulate the timestep: *(this+0) += a2 and store back into this+0.
Overflow guard: compare the accumulated time at this+0 against the threshold flt_59E43C; the normalization block runs only when the accumulated time exceeds it (evaluated via FP compare flags).
Compute the reciprocal of the accumulated time: v6 = 1.0 / *(this+0).
Reset the accumulators to zero: this+0, this+4, this+8.
Normalize the impulse accumulators into the scaled outputs: *(this+0xC) = (double)this+4 * reciprocal and *(this+0x10) = (double)this+8 * reciprocal.
Loop of 104 iterations that adds the timestep a2 to each contact-pair timer entry (two float timers per pair).
Return the pointer one past the end of the contact-pair timer block.
